descriptionHtml:
GIGABYTE Radeon RX 9060 XT GAMING OC 16G Graphics Card (16GB GDDR6 128-bit / AMD RDNA Architecture / Factory Overclocked / WINDFORCE 3X Triple Fan Cooling / RGB Fusion / Dual BIOS / Metal Backplate / DisplayPort 2.1 & HDMI 2.1 / 3 Years Official Local Agent Warranty)

Elevate your gaming rig with the GIGABYTE Radeon RX 9060 XT GAMING OC 16G graphics card, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 3-Year Local Agent Warranty. Featuring 16GB of high-speed GDDR6 memory and advanced AMD RDNA architecture, this factory-overclocked card delivers exceptional 1440p and 4K gaming performance alongside fluid frame rates. Equipped with the iconic WINDFORCE cooling system featuring three alternate spinning blade fans, composite copper heat pipes, 3D active fan technology, and screen cooling, it maintains optimal thermal performance under heavy gaming loads. Enhanced with customizable RGB Fusion lighting and a protective metal backplate, it is built for durability and premium aesthetics.
